newsitem.title: USA: Ill. Riverboat casino revenues up 4.03 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Ill. Riverboat casino revenues up 4.03 pct in May.

text.p: Illinois riverboat casino adjusted gross receipts rose 4.03 percent in May compared to April, but the take remained 10.28 percent less than that recorded the previous May, the Illinois Gaming Board reported.
Riverboats reported $92.81 million in adjusted gross receipts for May compared to $89.22 million for April and $103.45 million in May 1996, the gaming board reported.
Overall, cumulative adjusted gross receipts were down 13.1 percent from January through May 1997 compared to the same period in 1996, according to the gaming board release.
The riverboats reported receipts of $447.39 million from January through May of this year compared to $515.09 million for the same period in 1996.
